info.title: Traigent Content-less Token Issuance Route
info.description: Opaque token issuance of the content-less optimization channel (plan v2.1 phase 1b-2a). Flag-gated (CONTENT_LESS_TOKEN_REFS_ENABLED, default off).

post.summary: Issue knob, choice, metric or template refs for an agent
post.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/optimization_token_refs_routes.py. Resolves `agent_ref` inside the caller's tenant and project (tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only; X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused) and issues one ref per item, in order, idempotently by `operation_key`: a first request records a receipt and the token rows in ONE transaction; a replay with the same agent, item count and item list returns the stored refs and inserts nothing; any difference is 409 operation_key_conflict. While the flag is off the route answers the uniform unknown-route 404, byte-identical to a path that does not exist. ORDER OF REFUSALS: (1) unauthenticated 401 / forbidden 403; (2) body invalid 400 invalid_request (unknown field, bad key, bad kind, parent_ref rules, item count outside 1..200); (3) unknown, foreign or unreadable agent_ref or parent_ref 404 reference_not_found; (4) operation_key_conflict 409. Every error body of this route is the closed envelope in token_refs_schema.json#/definitions/TokenRefsRefusal except 401/403 (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) and 429.

200.description: Refs in request item order (a first issuance and an exact replay answer identically).

400.description: invalid_request. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope with fixed text.

403.description: forbidden. Closed envelope with fixed text.

404.description: reference_not_found (closed envelope), or the framework's uniform unknown-route 404 while the flag is off.

409.description: operation_key_conflict. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope with fixed text; no exception data.
